lines.en: I drift forward, half a step above the ground.
A golden aura trails behind me.
Loose stone is pushed aside by my wake.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是不想惊动谁
lines.en: I walk slowly so as not to alarm anyone.
My feet never land, so my steps are soft.
I have walked this street many times.
The ki rolls under my skin; I hold it down.
The wind lifts my bangs.
I move along the broken wall.
I float over the rubble without a sound.
One flicker and I am ten paces on.
I glance at the sky, then continue.
My aura shrinks little by little.
Eyes half shut, I steady my breath.
These ruins are far too quiet.
Ki gathers and releases in my palm.
I touch an old wound without thinking.
The dust in the wind tastes of iron.
I am counting how much time is left.
The far horizon has gone grey.
My breathing is steady; my heart is not.
While the ki holds, I do not fall.
I stare at my own hand.
Silence is also an answer.
Of that generation, only I remain.
I draw the power back into my bones.
I look up and recognize your ki.
Your ki is not small.
I will not strike first; you go.
There is no killing intent on you.
I have been watching you a while.
If you were an enemy, you would be trouble.
Your stance is not a fighter's.

lines.zh: 只剩一只手臂，我也挡得住你。
lines.en: Even with one arm, I can stop you.
I lift my chin and meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 这个世界的未来，你看得见吗
lines.en: Can you see this world's future?
You are young; you still have choices.
I will not ask your name.
I open my fist to show I will not fight.
You step back; I understand.
My golden hair stirs in the wind.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段沉默
lines.en: A silence stands between us.
You smell of the living.
I step back and steady my ki.
This wound is nothing.
I wipe the blood from my lip.
My ki scatters; I gather it at once.
I turned aside from the vital spot.
I grit my teeth and stay silent.
The pain sharpens me.
My ki guard took part of it.
I wipe the wound on my shoulder.
Still able to fight; do not worry.
Food? I am used to hunger.
Save that for the children.
The hand you offer is trembling.
I do not need it, but thank you.
Hunger taught me to eat little.
If you are hungry, eat it yourself.
I raise a hand: put it away.
A loaf of bread buys no peace.
I sniff it and do not take it.
Living is harder than eating enough.
My aura pushes you back on its own.
Do not bump me; the ki reacts.
I brace and keep you from falling.
That jostled my ki loose.
Shoulder to shoulder, I give half a step.
You stand at the edge of my aura; it burns.
I put out a hand to steady you.
Not so close; I cannot damp it.
The impact throws dust up.

lines.zh: 这一类的事，我没有余力
lines.en: I have no strength left for such things.
What I guard is not one person.
If peace came, perhaps.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你肩上，又收回
lines.en: I rest a hand on your shoulder, then withdraw.

lines.zh: 别把心放在我这种人身上
lines.en: Do not give your heart to someone like me.
I have only one road.

lines.zh: 同行可以，同行到最后难
lines.en: Walking together is easy; to the end is not.
I smile as if apologizing.
Beneath the gold, my face is tired.
Remembering you is enough.
Whose is this? Keep it safe.
A touch of ki lifts it.

lines.zh: 废墟里的东西，多半有主
lines.en: Things in ruins usually had owners.
I weigh it; it is light.
This is not what I came for.
Leave it for whoever comes after.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时气焰收了一下
lines.en: My aura dims as I bend.

lines.zh: 这东西不能落在坏人手里
lines.en: This must not fall into the wrong hands.
That ki shifted; I have it.
Your killing intent shows.
I raise my hand; ki gathers there.
No words needed. Come.
This time I will not hold back.
The Masenko is ready.
This fight must not drag on.
The moment you move, I know.
My aura surges higher.
Target confirmed. Begin.
You are quicker than I expected.

lines.zh: 我压低重心，等你的第一步
lines.en: I sink low and wait for your first step.
Do not touch the bystanders.
I pull my ki up to my throat.
I follow your ki.
Change position; I still know.
Ki blasts are not thrown blindly.

lines.zh: 我从上往下看你的动作
lines.en: I watch your moves from above.
I know this ground well.
A barrier rises before me.
You want my back; I can see it.
Ki compresses at my fingertips.
Your steps grow hurried.
I angle my body and slip a line.
Thirty paces; just right.
Do not think I miss what hides in the dark.
I have seen that technique before.
My aura is drawing inward.
Once more, and I answer.
My fist lands on your armor.
Second blow follows through.
That one came from the hips.
A knee strike; guard high.
Once I am close, you have no range.
A knife-hand cuts at your shoulder.
The punch wind scatters the dust.
I pull the blow; there is mercy in it.
That one was not heavy.
Ki coats my knuckles.
A pivot and a sweeping kick.
You blocked it. Good.
I do not pause; three blows in a row.
The last punch ends at my chest.
My elbow grazes your face.
I strike and step back.
My aura flares; I land here.
I walk out of the grey haze.
This is not my era.
The sky's color is wrong.
First I check the ki around me.
Golden light lights the rubble.
I did not choose where to land.
Is someone calling for help?
A ring of dust spirals up.
I straighten and draw my ki in.
Nothing living in this area.
Alone again.
There is still ash on my clothes.
Wind passes through the broken windows.
This place needs someone to guard it.
I push the hair from my forehead.
Flame licks up my arm.
I land too hard; my knee gives.
Ki is useless underwater.
The blast lifts me off the ground.
Something passed through my aura.
Spellforce works into my bones.
Too long hungry; my ki wavers.
Lightning rides my ki through my body.
Even my ki scatters here.
